title: L-Talks · Press Play

cold_open.line: [curious] What if... you had a second chance to make it right? What if you could practice that hard conversation — before it ever happened? What if you had a Double? An AI version of you. Talking like you. Reacting like you. Making choices like you. In Doubland, you build an AI Double from your personality. [warmly] Then you watch it live, in a world with other Doubles. Every conversation. Every choice. Every relationship. This season: L-Talks. A three-hundred-member alumni chat group. We analyzed a year of conversations. Found fifteen most active voices. Built their Doubles from what they said — no surveys, no interviews. Dropped them into Doubland. [excited] And pressed play.
